label: late original-phase steps after an h/e ... y/e/0/b/l prefix pattern (distributed history code)
explanation: Very sparse (0.0076% of steps), weak (max 0.22). Fires almost only in the original phase at t=3..7 (98% of mass), plus a few times on <DEL>, and never in the copy phase or at t<3. Activation seems to depend on a mix of which tokens appeared at which earlier positions: first token t/h/2/u/x/3/s, h or e two steps back, y/e/0/b/l one step back, and the current input 0/c/h/l/b/q. Each of these tokens has only modest lift (2-12x). Neither a conjunction of them (dev F1 0.18, precision 0.12, mass recall 0.34) nor a count of seen tokens (high recall, precision <1%) captures it, so it looks like a distributed hidden-state direction rather than a nameable token or position rule. No magnitude modulator was identified.
